plan.title: Reverse auction auto-title for two products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction while leaving the title untouched.
Apply the first offered auction pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Confirm an auction template was applied.
Add the first product without typing a title.
Set the first product's delivery location to Plant Name.
Confirm the first row has the requested location.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify the automatic title generated from the first product and location.
Add the second product from a different family while the title remains automatic.
Set the second product's delivery location to the same Plant Name.
Confirm the second row has the requested location.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB & more - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify the automatic multi-product title after the last location is selected.
Remove the second product to check that the untitled event title refreshes when rows are removed.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Confirm the title returns to the remaining product and location.
